conditions.evidence: characterize opioid use disorder and related contextual factors
conditions.label: opioid use disorder

output.population: De-identified patients with International Classification of Diseases (ICD-9) OUD diagnostic codes; two annotators reviewed discharge summaries from a random sample of 100 of these patients.
output.summary: Annotated corpus of MIMIC-III discharge summaries from patients with ICD-9 opioid use disorder codes, using a 33-class schema covering problematic opioid use and psychosocial context, built to support natural language processing methods.
